note: The alate is unknown; the soldier described here is based on paratype specimens.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The holotype soldier is deposited in the Forest Research Institute (FRI), Dehradun, India; type locality Teliamura, Tripura, India. The soldier antennae have only 8—10 segments, one of the lowest counts in the genus; the head capsule is 2/3 to 3/4 as wide as long. Distribution: Tripura, India.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule wider than long, the width 2/3 to 3/4 of the length; length 1.18—1.40 mm, width 0.88—0.93 mm; sides almost straight, posterior margin rounded; Y-shaped suture present; frons sloping forwards at nearly 45°, with a weak V-shaped depression. Eyes small, oval, white, at about their long diameter from the antennae. Ocelli very small, dot-like, at about half the eye's long diameter from the eye. Antennae 8—10-segmented; segment 1 long, cylindrical; segment 2 about half of segment 1, shortest in the 8-segmented antenna, almost as long as segment 3 in the 9—10-segmented antenna; in the paratype examined segment 3 is shortest; segment 4 to the penultimate pear-shaped; terminal segment narrower, oval, shorter than the preceding one. Mandibles short, stout, length 0.58—0.70 mm, about half the head length; outer margin raised at the base; left mandible with 3 marginal teeth, teeth 1 and 2 small and adjacent in the distal half, tooth 3 large and conspicuous below the middle, the margin between teeth 2 and 3 distinctly incurved; right mandible with 1 or 2 large marginal teeth in the basal half. Postmentum short, club-shaped; waist narrow, about half the greatest width, situated near the posterior end; length 0.70—0.93 mm, greatest width 0.33—0.40 mm, least width 0.15—0.20 mm. Pronotum flat, rectangular; anterior margin rather deeply incurved, with a very shallow median notch; posterior margin weakly bowed outwards, shallowly concave in the middle; sides converging backwards; width 0.75—0.85 mm, length 0.38—0.49 mm. Mesonotum as wide as or slightly wider than the pronotum, metanotum wider, both with almost straight posterior margins. Legs short, thick; tibial spur formula 3:3:3; tarsi 4-segmented. Abdomen elongate; tergite 10 sclerotized, pale brown; cerci 2-segmented; styli single-segmented.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Pseudoworker: head and body milky white, sparsely hairy. Body length 3.45—4.70 mm. Head capsule almost circular, slightly wider than long; length to the mandibular base 0.70—0.85 mm, width 0.80—0.90 mm. Eyes almost oval, vestigial. Antennae 9—11-segmented; segment 3 longer than segment 4, segment 4 shortest. Clypeus almost trapezoidal. Mandibles of the typical tree-termite type. Pronotum flat; anterior margin deeply incurved, posterior margin straight; length 0.35—0.48 mm, width 0.70—0.80 mm. Legs and abdomen as in the soldier.
